annotations.title: Build GovCon IGCE, Indirect Wrap-Rate & Price-to-Win (PTW) Model

description: Model an Independent Government Cost Estimate (IGCE), compounded Indirect Wrap-Rate breakdown (Fringe, Overhead, G&A, and Fee/Profit), GSA CALC+ aligned LCAT rate card, multi-year Section B CLIN pricing schedule, 4-scenario Price-to-Win (PTW) sensitivity matrix, and Shipley Volume IV Basis of Estimate (BOE) narrative from RFP Section B/SOW text. This is a read-only, stateless financial modeling and estimation call (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; `rfp_section_b_and_sow_text` accepts 30 to 120,000 characters, optional `historical_benchmark_and_incumbent_context` and `bidder_indirect_wrap_assumptions` anchor indirect multipliers and incumbent baselines, and `evaluation_methodology` calibrates FAR 15.101-1 Best-Value Tradeoff vs. LPTA or FAR 15.404-1(d) Cost Realism). Use this tool when building forward-looking Volume IV Price/Cost models, wrap-rate build-ups, and Price-to-Win targets; use `search_historical_awards` instead to query past FPDS/SAM award records, or `extract_pricing_schedule` to parse an existing vendor quote or invoice table.

bidder_indirect_wrap_assumptions.description: Optional bidder indirect rate assumptions (Fringe %, Overhead %, G&A %, Target Fee/Profit %, annual productive hours per FTE such as 1,880 or 1,920, and annual Option Year escalation %).

historical_benchmark_and_incumbent_conte.description: Optional incumbent contract value, FPDS/USAspending historical award benchmarks, GSA MAS SIN 54151S CALC+ ceiling rates, or known agency budget ceilings to anchor the IGCE and Price-to-Win model.

rfp_section_b_and_sow_text.description: Raw RFP Section B (Supplies or Services and Prices/Costs), PWS/SOW level-of-effort & LCAT staffing requirements, contract type (FFP, T&M, Labor-Hour, CPFF), Period of Performance (Base + Option Years), and Place of Performance (Contractor-site vs. Government-site).

cost_realism_and_price_reasonableness_po.description: FAR 15.404-1 Price Reasonableness and Cost Realism risk posture.

independent_government_cost_estimate_igc.description: Estimated Independent Government Cost Estimate (IGCE) baseline ($ USD) across the full PoP.

lcat_rate_card_and_fte_buildup.description: Bottom-up LCAT staffing, unburdened direct wage, burdened bill rate, and GSA CALC+ benchmark table.

ptw_sensitivity_scenarios.description: 4-scenario Price-to-Win sensitivity matrix with Pwin impact and SSEB tradeoff analysis.

recommended_price_to_win_usd.description: Recommended total evaluated Price-to-Win ($ USD) across Base and all Option Years.

wrap_rate_calculator_breakdown.description: Compounded Fringe, Overhead, G&A, and Fee/Profit wrap-rate breakdown.
